record.reason: Delayed supervision trains test-time language-model memory to answer later questions from accumulated streams. The body reports comparisons against original/event-next-token-prediction baselines, but explicitly says it does not isolate delay's causal effect and makes no universal superiority claim; no inference-latency/throughput gain is established, so relevance to runtime-efficiency literature is weak.
record.title: Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models
